opus.problem: Clue 3 overlaps heavily with clue 2. Both say this father begged Jesus because his daughter was dying; clue 3 only adds her age and that she was an only child. Replace one with a different fact.

The best-known part of the story is missing. No clue covers Jesus taking the girl by the hand, saying 'Talitha koum,' and her rising and walking (Mark 5:41-42), or her parents being astonished and told to give her something to eat. One of the overlapping clues should be swapped for this.
